messages:
incident-bot: [Pager] P2 - token-service latency/error spike in us-east-1. Alerts: 5xx increase on /v1/generate and timeout >99th pct. Detected 2026-03-17T13:58:32Z. Bridge: https://incidents.redwood/bridge/ABC123. Paging maya-oncall.
maya-oncall: On bridge. TL;DR: KV-cache eviction storm + sudden request fanout. Scaled the pool at 14:01 UTC, reduced error rate but still elevated. Customer-facing impact: transient timeouts for a subset of hosted API keys.
sam-sre: Taking primary oncall. Can you paste the initial metrics + any error traces? Need rough customer impact estimate for comms.
maya-oncall: Pasting quick snapshot:
```
metric: token_service.5xx_rate us-east-1 = 0.058 (baseline 0.004)
metric: token_service.latency_p95 us-east-1 = 2.3s (baseline 0.45s)
logs: kvcache.evict_count spike ~ +12k at 13:57:xx
```
Impact: approx 3 enterprise customers saw increased timeouts (we have alerts tied to customer-key). No data exfiltration.
lex-product: Important: product/customer teams want an initial impact estimate for SLA/credits and whether any requests were dropped permanently. Can someone estimate ETA for a short writeup?
tonI-legal: @toni-legal here — legal needs an initial record of affected accounts + any customer escalations. Please flag if we need to prepare a legal-safe comms.
rai-ops: (reacts :eyes:) Is there a public status incident yet? If not we should publish a short notice.
maya-oncall: Not yet. Recommend status: "Degraded performance for hosted API in us-east-1; mitigation in progress". Sam, do you want to publish?
sam-sre: I'll draft a short status and post. Also assigning RCA owner — Kai volunteered on bridge. @kai-eng can you take the RCA draft?
kai-eng: I can own the RCA draft. Will collect timeline, logs, config changes, and mitigation steps. Planning to have first draft within 24h and a full postmortem within 72h.
lex-product: Please include customer-visible timeline + per-customer impact notes (keys A, B, C) — we'll need to correlate request logs.
toni-legal: Also flag any customers who reported financial impact. We'll need to loop in account teams.
rania-ops: Created tracking ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/OPS-4321 — please add owners/action items. I'll keep the action tracker up to date.
sam-sre: Mitigations performed (timeline): 13:58 - spike detected; 13:59 - autoscale triggered; 14:01 - manual pool scale + KV cache TTL increase; 14:12 - observed error rate drop to ~1.5x baseline. Root cause hypothesis: sudden TTL misconfiguration causing cache thrash, which increased DB thundering and raised token-service latency.
maya-oncall: Evidence: JVM GC + connection pool exhaustion logs around spike window. Also noticed a recent deploy 2026-03-17T12:45 by deploy-bot to token-service (commit ab12f). Adding that to RCA TODO.
kai-eng: For the RCA timeline I need: deploy change list, KV-config diff, traffic heatmap, per-client request patterns, and a copy of the deploy job. Can owners attach or point me to artifacts?
rania-ops: Jupyter with request heatmap: https://notebooks.redwood/heatmap/12345. KV-config snapshot: s3://configs/prod/token-service/2026-03-17/kvcfg.json. I can grant access.
lex-product: Scheduling: propose postmortem review meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC (48h window). Attendees: Kai (author), Sam (oncall), Maya (bridge), Lex (product), Toni (legal) and account owners. Anyone object?
sam-sre: Works for me.
maya-oncall: Works.
tonI-legal: Works — I'll be there to confirm comms language.
kai-eng: I'll have a dry-run draft in #postmortems 24h before the meeting (i.e., by 14:30 UTC tomorrow). Requesting a peer reviewer: @sam-sre volunteered earlier; can we add one more technical reviewer?
sam-sre: I'll be primary reviewer; @lex-product can do customer impact + comms review.
rania-ops: Action items so far (I'll own the tracker):
- Attach logs + snapshots to OPS-4321 (owner: Maya)
- Collect per-customer request logs (owner: Rania Ops, due: +24h)
- Validate deploy diff and rollback plan (owner: Kai, due: +24h)
- Draft status comms and customers to notify (owner: Sam, due: 1h)
- Legal review for comms (owner: Toni, due: +6h)
- Postmortem meeting & RCA draft (owner: Kai, draft +24h, meeting +48h)
Please update owners if wrong.
maya-oncall: I'll attach logs to the ticket now. Also note: there's a small chance a rollout flag was flipped in the deploy that increased TTL to 0 for a subset of requests — flagged to Kai.
kai-eng: Good catch — I'll add config diff verification to the timeline.
lex-product: After RCA sign-off we'll need a short customer-facing post for status.redwood.com and personalized emails for the three affected enterprise customers. Sam, can you coordinate email drafts?
sam-sre: Yes. I'll post drafts to the ticket and ping account owners.
toni-legal: Once drafts are up, I'll review and request edits.
rania-ops: Closing loop: schedule created in calendar: https://calendar.redwood/event/pm-rca-2501234567-2026-03-18T15:00Z. I've invited the list above.
kai-eng: Thanks. I'll start the timeline reconstruction and post the first draft in this thread and OPS-4321. Any other concerns?
lex-product: One ask: include cost impact estimate due to autoscaling. Product/finance may need that for SLA calculations.
rania-ops: Added a finance subtask in OPS-4321 (owner: finance-team, due +48h).
sam-sre: Closing note: no data loss detected. Main customer impact was increased latency and request timeouts, short-lived. Will update if anything new appears.
maya-oncall: Thanks all. Marking pager resolved in bridge at 14:28 UTC — following up in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
